parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates traveler-facing tier-1 exposures: federal birth-sex facility ban, passport/visa discrepancy scrutiny with possible fraud ineligibility, and documented abusive custody including hormone removal and sexual abuse. Oklahoma adds a binding birth-sex definition for state-owned facilities, bathrooms and incarceration, plus K-12 facility bans, with no state gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime protection and foreclosed marker changes as climate signals. No trans-presentation crime, organised police targeting, or private-sector facility ban is documented, and federal courts, hate-crime prosecution and litigation provide partial recourse, with several orders enjoined. That combination is an unremedied universal government-facility and border-document exposure, but narrower than all-public-building bans and without the repeated ward abuse or police extortion in the 0.35 anchors.
